items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: people like Mike Brecker, Randy, the young soloists, if they did a date with a pop star

ctx.x: Never count your royalties until the chickens come home, baby. So I, you know, easy bread. But yeah, I mean I mean the Billy Joel thing I got more attention, you know, but I never, I never felt like using it in my publicity because I mean the people that had been following my career, and I go way back before Billy Joel, I mean people that were buying Quill and Phil and my early Prestige stuff, I can never say that, you know, “Phil Woods … Billy Joel’s alto player,” you know. I could’ve played “Just the Way…” I…
